latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release—comprehensive skill for web application defensive posture assessment:

- Assesses input validation quality, information disclosure, architectural security, and server hardening.
- Provides structured guidance for both white-box (source code) and black-box (traffic/config) reviews.
- Covers error handling, trust boundary validation, canonicalization, and configuration weaknesses.
- Maps findings to relevant CWE categories and recommends countermeasures.
- Designed for use in pre-deployment security reviews, penetration tests, architecture assessments, and configuration audits.
